notes: 1.50.16: KNL Tiêu chuẩn bậc — after a successful Save the grid looked visually identical to the unsaved diagonal-baseline prefill (e.g. KNL_TRUONG_KHO_PHF_V2_0E47A5 on Production), so Admin couldn't tell saved data from a client-side draft. Traced end-to-end: knl_save_grade_matrix really does delete-then-insert inside one transaction (confirmed against the RPC source, no fake success), and the post-save reload already refetches getKnlGradeMatrix from the backend — the gap was purely visual, no persistence bug. Added a persistent status badge (reusing the existing .phfk-source-status/is-ready/is-review pill, no new CSS) next to the grid heading with 3 states driven by real state, not a one-time toast: 'Chưa lưu · baseline khởi tạo' (never saved), 'Đã lưu' (saved, matches backend), 'Có thay đổi chưa lưu' (saved before, but Admin touched a cell/added/removed a bậc since). foundationState.gradeDirty tracks this explicitly: cleared on every fresh load/version switch and right after a successful save, set on any grade-cell onchange (only when the matrix already has saved grades — a still-unsaved matrix is already covered by the CHƯA LƯU badge, dirty tracking doesn't apply to it) and on every add/remove-bậc action. Cell edits update the badge immediately via direct DOM text/class swap, not a full grid re-render, so in-progress selections in other cells aren't lost. Verified with a stateful jsdom mock (persisted grades/requirements actually update on save and are what a fresh reload reads back) that: empty 4/5-level matrices open as CHƯA LƯU; Save flips to ĐÃ LƯU; a brand-new DOM/window simulating F5 reads ĐÃ LƯU purely from the mocked backend response; editing a cell on a saved matrix flips to CÓ THAY ĐỔI CHƯA LƯU before Save is even clicked; saving again returns to ĐÃ LƯU. Did not touch publish/lock/assignment/permission or any KNL data outside Admin-initiated Save.
